summary: Displays a referenced Panel Component from another location, optionally matching or overriding the referenced panel's size.

key_params.name: matchsize
key_params.note: Match this COMP width/height to referenced panel

key_params.name: followselection
key_params.note: Resolve dimensions through nested Select COMPs

key_params.name: fixedaspect
key_params.note: Choose off, use horizontal, or use vertical fixed-aspect sizing

common_gotchas: Select COMP selects Panel Components for display; it is not a generic object/reference component.
It does not support child panels through its output connector or embedded panels.
Recursive selection is allowed: selecting a Select COMP displays what that Select COMP points to.
Match Size copies referenced dimensions; otherwise Width and Height can resize the selected panel.
Follow Selection resolves dimensions from the upper-most non-Select COMP in nested selection chains.
Use Container COMP or Base COMP when the goal is to own child networks rather than display a remote panel.
